acceptance_cases.name: Sign-in and verified identity
acceptance_cases.operation: Official SDK sign-in; backend token/project/lifetime verification; direct signup-denial negative; conditional genuine wrong-project token.
acceptance_cases.expected: Linked exact internal identities; 401 invalid/expired, 403 unlinked, 503 unavailable; no signup or fallback.
acceptance_cases.failure: Wrong identity or token accepted, automatic linking, service signup, or fallback.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Live sign-in and subject provisioning; helper issuer needs independent approval; natural expiry window.
acceptance_cases.unresolved: Valid wrong-project issuer unavailable; no second project implicitly authorized.

acceptance_cases.name: Revocation, disable/delete and outages
acceptance_cases.operation: Retain pre-action token in memory; revoke, disable/re-enable, independently approved D deletion; isolated service/certificate failures.
acceptance_cases.expected: No protected access with old tokens; revoked/disabled 401; service unavailable 503; deleted status observed without assuming 401.
acceptance_cases.failure: Old token authorizes, skipped revocation, outage fallback or unrelated account affected.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Exact subject/actions, deletion separately opt-in, scoped network faults and operator permissions.

acceptance_cases.name: Logout
acceptance_cases.operation: SDK logout, back navigation, no-token requests and delayed reads/streams, account switch and independent second tab.
acceptance_cases.expected: Local private state cleared, stale results rejected, no-token 401; other tab independent; no global-revocation claim.
acceptance_cases.failure: Previous-account cache, resurrected sign-in, fallback or false global logout.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Live session tests; separate G2B-07 authorization if server-wide revocation is required.

acceptance_cases.name: Password change/reset
acceptance_cases.operation: Approved reset requests and official hosted handler; expiry, single-use, recipient/domain scope and old-session checks.
acceptance_cases.expected: Generic known/unknown outcome; genuine action binding/expiry/replay enforcement; approved old-session policy enforced.
acceptance_cases.failure: Enumeration, action replay, expiry acceptance, old-token authorization or mail outside approved inboxes.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Real mail, recipient/action host, password changes and timed expiry; no application change-password UI exists.
acceptance_cases.unresolved: Delivery, real expiry and provider abuse protections unqualified.

acceptance_cases.name: Recovery/account change
acceptance_cases.operation: Approved real reauthentication/recovery and identity-change procedure; link/audit/approver revocation.
acceptance_cases.expected: Exact UID association; no email merge or ownership transfer; revoked approvals deny access.
acceptance_cases.failure: Self-approved elevation, stale link, overwritten historical approval or false completed recovery workflow.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Recovery identity policy and reviewed linking/account-change procedure/tooling before writes.
acceptance_cases.unresolved: Complete application recovery/reauthentication/account-change and link-approval workflow not implemented.

acceptance_cases.name: Cross-user ownership
acceptance_cases.operation: New synthetic project/file/result-identity/history own versus cross-user reads and safe metadata probes.
acceptance_cases.expected: Own access only; 401 invalid/missing, 403 or policy 404 other owner; no forged role/ID, stale substitution or private history.
acceptance_cases.failure: Cross-user access, original-data/ledger reference, role escalation or execution of prohibited workloads.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: New fixtures and reviewed harmless probes; no solver/import/export execution tests even as denial probes.
acceptance_cases.unresolved: Live ownership unqualified; synthetic records do not qualify engineering truth or cloud durability.

acceptance_cases.name: Browser session policy
acceptance_cases.operation: Reload/close/multiple tabs, token refresh/real expiry, rejected sessions, stale async boundaries and persistence inspection.
acceptance_cases.expected: Memory-only per tab, re-login after reload, no legacy/cookie fallback, no account bleed; revocation on next protected request.
acceptance_cases.failure: Durable Firebase tokens, old private data, unintended tab sharing or unauthorized/replayed requests.
acceptance_cases.additional_approval: Session limitations and live timed window; server-wide revocation separately approved.
acceptance_cases.unresolved: Real browser/provider lifecycle and production HTTPS/XSS qualification remain pending.
